_doc: Maps a new game can start on (sim/world.py MAPS, play). difficulty = the map's default (docs/logic/difficulty.md 'Per map'); python3 -m sim new --difficulty, POST /control {new, difficulty} override it. episode = 'CAMPAIGN#SLOT' of data/campaign: the open play's own episode, applied at a new game as the exe does (its player city's raw goods and allowed table: sandbox hides the carrot and onion farms and the urchin quay; oracle runs sandbox-food, sandbox2-food). map = play another entry's map and data (scenario, empire) without its episode: everything buildable (ours, 2026-10-31; the benchmarks scripts/*.txt and saves made before 10-31). title / note: the new-game screen's name and description line for ours. Hand-edited.

sandbox_open.title: Sandbox (ours)
sandbox_open.note: Ours: every building can be built (the original's sandbox has no carrot or onion farm and no urchin quay).

sandbox2_open.title: Sandbox 2 (ours)
sandbox2_open.note: Ours: every building can be built (the original's Sandbox 2 has no carrot or onion farm, no fishery and no urchin quay).
